{#- Layout for the community pages: everything outside conf///. The community pages share the conference design, so the two halves of the site look like one site. The styles come from the conference SCSS (_static/conf/scss/_conference.scss), compiled in navy with the community additions in _community.scss into main-community.min.css. From top to bottom: - community/navbar.html: header menu and search, from _data/community.yaml - a photo banner with the page title: the page's `banner` field, or a default from _data/community.yaml - the page, with the page's sections alongside on wide screens - community/signup.html: mailing list signup - community/sponsors.html: the sponsors of the whole site - shared/footer.html: the footer, shared with the conference pages The front page uses community/index.html, which swaps the banner for a hero. -#} {%- extends "!layout.html" %} {%- from "community/navbar.html" import navbar, offcanvas with context %} {%- block extrahead %} {{ super() }} {#- The blog's Atom feed, for feed readers given a page's address. ablog sets feed_path; its own page.html added this link, which the basic theme's templates don't. #} {%- if feed_path %} {%- endif %} {#- Verifies the site on our Mastodon profile; the footer no longer links to Mastodon. #} {#- Lets community.js read the Read the Docs addons' settings (search). #} {#- The banner is a CSS background, which browsers only find after the CSS. #} {%- endblock %} {%- block body_tag %}{% endblock %} {%- block header %} Skip to content {%- if announcement_message %}
